description: RiverWare—A River and Reservoir Modeling Tool is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Colorado Boulder | Center for Advanced Decision Support for Water and Environmental Systems; U.S. Bureau of Reclamation; Tennessee Valley Authority. This advanced water resource modeling tool gives licensed users a way to model any river basin. Users who would like to view the output of model runs can request a free RiverWare Viewer License. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
